Method of Attack: Distributed through phishing emails with attached Word or Excel documents containing malicious macros
Tricks user into enabling macros that download Emotet malware
Steals victims' emails for reply-chain attacks
Installs other malware leading to Conti ransomware attack
Downloads additional payloads including Cobalt Strike
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious macro-enabled Word or Excel attachments
Password-protected zip files or HTML files leading to zip files
Malicious macros executed upon enabling content
Indicators of Compromise: Emails impersonating IRS.gov with subjects like 'IRS Tax Forms W-9', 'Incorrect Form Selection', 'INCOME TAX RETURN 2021'
Password-protected zip attachments containing 'W-9 form.xslm' Excel files
Malicious macros downloading Emotet from hacked WordPress sites
